decisions.reason: As a close-to-core component with broad use in air-cooler applications, it likely has low carrying cost and good fit with the firm's engineering, manufacturing, and service base, so the option value of keeping it remains attractive in a growing market.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are a scalable, adjacent improvement that can feed multiple existing product lines and customer segments, so with no clear negative signal and relatively low cost to maintain, management would keep this option open.
